A '''deepdock fleet''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] commanded by a [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|fleet admiral]]. It was comprised of a [[force escort]], two [[deepdock complex]]es, an [[engineering corps]], two [[force technical services]], and a [[force support]], for an average of 280 support [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

Information on them was included in the official field manual for the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]], ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', including critical information on the deepdock complexes. After the book was released to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] found this information and used it for a plan to overtake the [[Vorzyd sector/Legends|Vorzyd sector]].<ref name="IHB" />
